Creates a new checkout link for a domain listed in SellerHub.

Checkout links provide a direct URL that can be shared with potential buyers, allowing them to purchase a domain at a specified price without requiring them to browse the marketplace.

### Use Cases
- Share a personalized purchase link with an interested buyer
- Create campaign-specific links for marketing purposes
- Generate time-limited offers for domain sales

### Notes
- The domain must already be listed in SellerHub before creat

params.name: take
params.description: Number of response items per page. Required; integer between 1 and the operation-specific upper bound.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results. Obtained from the `cursor` field in a previous response. Omit on the first request.

params.name: saleDateTimeFrom
params.description: Inclusive lower bound for the sale time filter as a full ISO-8601 UTC datetime (e.g., `2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z`). When specified without `saleDateTimeTo`, returns all records from this date onwards. Must be earlier than `saleDateTimeTo` when both are provided.

params.name: saleDateTimeTo
params.description: Exclusive upper bound for the sale time filter as a full ISO-8601 UTC datetime (e.g., `2024-01-16T00:00:00.000Z`). When specified without `saleDateTimeFrom`, returns all records before this date. Must be later than `saleDateTimeFrom` when both are provided.

Returns a cursor-paginated list of domains that have been sold through SellerHub.

This endpoint uses cursor-based pagination. To retrieve the first page, omit the `cursor` query parameter.
For subsequent pages, pass the `cursor` value from the previous response.

### Pagination
- Set `take` to control the page size (1-100).
- If the response includes a `cursor`, more results are available.
- If `cursor` is absent, you have reached the last page.

Returns a paginated list of SafePay transactions the caller is a party to — as buyer, seller, or (for a broker) the originating broker.

### Pagination
- Set `take` (required, 1-100) to control the page size.
- Set `skip` (required, 0 or greater) to control the offset from the start of the result set.
- Omitting `take` or `skip` returns a `400 Bad Request`.
- Read `total` from the response for the overall number of matching transactions.

Opens a SafePay (escrow) transaction for a domain sale. The endpoint returns immediately; the counterparty confirms out of band.

The initiator role is stated via `initiatedBy` (`seller`, `buyer`, or `broker`). The returned `status` shows which side must still act (`pendingSellerConfirm` or `pendingBuyerConfirm`), or `active` when no confirmation remains.
